verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Bread for the world
A world of hunger

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Wine for all peoples
People who thirst

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
May we who eat
Be bread for others

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
May we who drink
Pour out our love

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Lord Jesus Christ
You are the bread of life

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Broken to reach
And heal the wounds of human pain

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Where we divide your people
You are waiting there

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
On bended knee
To wash our feet with endless care

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Lord Jesus Christ
You are the wine of peace

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Poured into hearts once broken
And where dryness sleeps

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
Where we are tired and weary
You are waiting there

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
To be the way which beckons us
Beyond despair

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Lord Jesus Christ
You call us to your feast

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
At which the rich and pow'rful
Have become the least.

verse.name: v3c
verse.lines:
Where we survive on others
In our human greed

verse.name: v3d
verse.lines:
You walk among us
Begging for your ev'ry need.
